corpus.note: Queries and expected ids were selected from the live personal corpus and frozen here. The corpus keeps growing and decaying; expectations are never re-derived from live ranks during a run. Re-select a case only when its target is legitimately superseded or deleted. Fix round 1 (2026-11-18) reviewed identifier owner families, corrected the file:line ground truth, and replaced two duplicate-explosion queries; see mustIncludeSemantics.

surfaces.rest: GET /api/memory/search?query=<q>&topK=3 (raw index surface, no reranker, no graph expansion)

metricDefinitions.restHit1: an expected id appears at REST rank 1
metricDefinitions.restHit3: an expected id appears in REST top 3
metricDefinitions.autoHit: an expected id appears in any injected #mem- pointer (neighbour lines count as injected evidence)
metricDefinitions.autoRank: rank of the first expected id among anchor (non-neighbour) lines only; neighbour lines never compete for ranking, so a target injected only as a neighbour has hit=true and rank=null
metricDefinitions.falseInjection: a negative entry injects any #mem- pointer at all
metricDefinitions.staleInjection: a must_exclude (superseded) id appears in the auto-recall pointers
metricDefinitions.entrypointAgreement: REST hit@3 equals auto inclusion on positive entries
metricDefinitions.noteBoard: note-board / user-profile / agent-priors blocks are stripped before id parsing; they are must-surface, not related recall

mustIncludeSemantics.rule: must_include is an any-of family of frozen, genuinely equivalent correct answers. A hit means at least one family member was returned; it is NOT a ranked gold list.
mustIncludeSemantics.activeOnly: Every must_include member must be ACTIVE at freeze time. Retrieval rewrites superseded hits to their chain head (resolveSupersededHeads), so a superseded expectation can never be returned; verifyFixtureIds fails the run when it finds superseded_by on a must_include id. must_exclude members are intentionally superseded and are exempt.
mustIncludeSemantics.identifierFamilies: Identifier queries list every reviewed active owner/answer for that identifier (e.g. all active memories where NOTE_BOARD_BUDGET is the subject, or all memories that directly record a commit). Superseded memories are never included; they belong in must_exclude.
mustIncludeSemantics.nearDuplicateFamilies: Paraphrase queries list the reviewed near-duplicate answers for the same fact. Merely related memories are excluded even when they share vocabulary.
mustIncludeSemantics.rejectedFamilies: Queries whose answer space is an uncontrolled duplicate explosion (settle-not-meta: 142 active near-duplicates; pipeline-heartbeat: 58) were replaced rather than given an arbitrary sub-family, because any omitted correct duplicate would re-introduce fixture-artifact misses.
